messages.en: Meow~
I just got back after eating a lot with Kim Chaewon.
Stir-fried baby octopus and pork.
This place is seriously so good…
The octopus pieces are basically the size of a whole octopus.
I'm at the dorm now.
I'm not on vacation right now~
Hayeon doesn't have a break this time.
Honestly? I like it!!
Gotta work.
But in between,
I'm getting plenty of rest.
So don't worry!!!!
Also,
Dessert and bread too~
Whose hand is that? I'm jealousㅠ
Jealous?
That's my hand hehe.
I ate a huge breakfast too.
Truffle abalone kimbap.
Guess we won't be seeing Hayoi's abs anymore.
No ㅋㅋㅎ but...
Today my stylist said,

messages.ko: 평소에 너가 살쪘다했을땐 못느꼈는데 요즘에는 무슨말하는지 알것같아..
messages.en: "When you said you gained weight before, I couldn't really tell, but lately I think I understand what you mean..."
"I'm seriously going on a diet this time."
And less than 3 minutes later...
"I'd like a chocolate shake please~~"
ㅋㅎㅋㅎㅋㅎㅎ
What are you doing now?
I ate sweet potato flavored walnut cakes and cream cheese flavored ones.
Now I'm having a sugar crash.
???: I'm seriously going on a diet.
HEY HEY HEY.
I still held back during promotions though.
Instead of eating 2 ramens, I only ate 1.
Instead of mixing 5 pieces of Spam with rice, I only ate 3.

messages.ko: 하연아 너가 돼지여도 난 너 좋아해
messages.en: Hayeon, even if you became a pig I'd still like you.
That's something I can't accept.
Kim Chaewon's appetite has been crazy lately.
She keeps taking me out to eat.
So I'm the only one leveling up my weight.
And lately...
Whenever I eat anything,
my stomach acts up.
I'm going crazy.
My body feels weird.
Then why do you keep eating...
That's the one thing I can't give up!!!!!
Even when I had COVID, I ordered Yupdduk.
I couldn't taste anything, but I still kept eating.
So before,
my mom told me I should become a mukbang YouTuber.
She really did.
My brother would do the editing,
and mom and dad would be the investors.
ㅋㅋㄹㄹㅋㄹㄹㅋㄹ
What would the channel name be?
Pig Power Max Hayeon.
Shortened to Dwaemaekha.
Okay, I seriously can't anymore.
I'm gonna go to the bathroom~
You don't have to tell us thatㅠㅠ
ㅋㄹㄹㅋㅋㄹㅋㄹㄹㅋ Ah, did that ruin the mood?
Hayeon will go read a book and come back~
I even showered and did a face pack~

messages.ko: 나 요즘 듣는노래만 들어서 들을게 없어
messages.en: These days I only listen to the same songs, so I have nothing new to listen to.
Recommend me some songs.
Baby Flower is the best though~
What other songs are good?
Go listen to Baby Flower already.
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹ
There are still people who can't find my parts.
No, I mean in the B-side tracks.
ㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋ
Now I'm really, really, really going to sleep.
I'll come back again~
Sleep well~
Haranghae ❤️
